product.title: Private Magical Waterfall Tour

description.text: Explore the ancient volcanoes and cascading waterfalls of the Kohala Mountains on a thrilling private helicopter tour from Kona. With up to 1 hour 15 minutes in the air, this flight covers all seven windward valleys of Kohala in one itinerary. Stops include Kohala Mountains, Waipio Valley, Waimanu Valley, Honokane Nui, Kohala Coast. Enjoy spectacular aerial views as you fly over Waipio Valley and Waimanu Valley, swoop over Honokane Nui and Kohala volcano, then circle back along the coast. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
